rationale: Correct the existing Dauntless Energy record in place to Skyline Renewables, the identity in Ardian's census holding, live infrastructure portfolio and 2025 integrated report. Primary evidence disproves the repository's rebrand claim: Dauntless Energy was formed separately in summer 2024 to manage the distinct Skyline Renewables and 1370 Clean Energy portfolios. Preserve the existing Ardian ownership period, AAIF IV fund attribution and 2018 entry for Skyline; remove the unsupported duplicate vehicle text, correct the company boundary, headquarters, founding year and historical milestones, and retain projects beneath Skyline rather than creating additional PortCos. Ardian's exact Skyline stake, security class, immediate holding vehicle and platform-equity closing day are not publicly disclosed. No Skyline-level sale, completed exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Skyline Renewables
companyFieldUpdates.description: Skyline Renewables is an Ardian-backed portfolio of operating and development-stage wind and solar generation assets in the United States. Ardian and Transatlantic Power Holdings created Skyline in 2018, and Ardian identifies it as an Ardian Americas Infrastructure Fund IV investment. Ardian's 2025 integrated report continues to include Skyline in its infrastructure portfolio, while Skyline's current public page says it is managed by Dauntless Energy from Arlington, Virginia. Dauntless is a separate management company formed in 2024 to manage Skyline and 1370 Clean Energy; it is not a legal rename of Skyline, and 1370 is not consolidated into this record. Individual generation projects remain assets beneath Skyline. Ardian reported more than 1,050 MW of controlled wind and solar capacity in 2020, while Dauntless's current profile describes approximately 1 GW of Skyline managed assets. Public sources do not disclose Ardian's exact Skyline stake, security class, immediate holding vehicle or exact platform-equity closing day, and no Skyline-level exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.
